overall_explanation: Original A911-06 Source, semantic Reader, and Quality are supported: the complete unchanged endpoint/store contracts and vectors preserve their PASS scopes, while the four terminal semantic assessments cover network, stores, CI, and product workflows. The five CI redactions exclude assignment literals and execution semantics, but the supplied CI assessment still establishes the bounded authored authority/identity/limits/transitions/failure meaning; they do not demonstrate a material gap in the original authored-binding criterion. Preserved limits include no Source-exhaustiveness, live runtime, deployment, release, human-practical-reader, or broader-gate acceptance, and the original DATA/Knip/external-provenance limitations remain open.
